g.text: Independent numerical performance — same controller and hardware
Two independent banks: 3,072 targets and 24 paths each. Bars average banks; dots in (a) show individual banks.
Path completion requires every checked deviation ≤ 0.5 mm. Curve in (d) pools 3,888 checks per design; checks are correlated within paths.
